name: Very Customizable Ruler - Secret Geneva Machanism Pencil Box - Trapped Sphere Pencil Topper

captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a customizable pocket ruler with a beveled scale edge. The main body is a thin rectangular plate with one long edge sloped downwards to form a bevel, which hosts engraved millimeter and centimeter scale markings. A circular keychain hole is located in one of the top corners opposite the scale edge.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric ruler in OpenSCAD with a customizable length, width, and bevel. The model should feature engraved millimeter and centimeter markings on the bevel, a circular hole for a keychain, and support for adding custom raised text on the main flat surface.
captions.factory: The script constructs the ruler's base using a hull() operation between a main rectangular cube and a thin, offset cube to form the bevel. A difference() operation is used to subtract a cylinder for the keychain hole and two for-loops of small, rotated cubes representing the major (centimeter) and minor (millimeter) scale markings. Finally, the write library is used to add raised text labels and numeric markings on top of the ruler.
